title: Deserialization Exploitation Quick Reference
description: Standard workflow for Java/PHP/Python serialization characteristics
detail: Java: characteristics include the rememberMe cookie, RMI, JMX, and long Base64 blobs; prefer ysoserial chains (if unavailable, switch approaches). PHP: unserialize entry point (starts with O:NN:) → phar trigger → __destruct file-write gadget. Python: pickle blob → __reduce__ RCE. Principle: find the entry point before finding the chain; nuclei tags=deserialization can help locate candidates.
